summary.en: Marchand belongs to the commerce family, from a reconstructed popular Latin mercatantem/mercatare based on mercatus ‘market’. French marcher and English march follow a Germanic mark-/markon path involving marking/trampling/stepping. They are not one historical word family.
summary.zh-Hans: marchand 属商业词族，来自据 mercatus“市场”重构的俗拉丁语 mercatantem／mercatare；法语 marcher 与英语 march 走日耳曼 mark-／markon 的标记、踩踏、迈步路径。二者不是同一历史词族。

claim.en: Marchand belongs to the commerce family, from a reconstructed popular Latin mercatantem/mercatare based on mercatus ‘market’. French marcher and English march follow a Germanic mark-/markon path involving marking/trampling/stepping. They are not one historical word family.

claim.en: Merchant/trade meaning comes from the market/merx family, not from walking.
